name: Starter B: what have they seen?
engine: Pick one first-half attack to play for show, and change each man's kind of move so their defence is set for the wrong thing.
about: Their defence learns. Guessing is a rule of every match for both teams: each defence remembers the last kind of move each attacker tried (a run, a cross, a cut-back, a ball in behind, a pass); the same kind again from him is +2 to the defender, any other kind +2 to him. Show them one side: once, on the first decision of one of your first-half attacks, press "Show them this attack". That attack is for show (nothing in it can end in a goal, and it costs no stamina) and every attack after it has their defence stretched from its second decision (+2 to a pass through, a cut-back, a pull-back or a pass across the goal).
decisions: Choose which attack to give away: an attack that starts deep costs you little to play for show.
Change each man's kind of move: the same move twice from one man is +2 to his defender.
On defence, meet their man the way he came last time: that is +2 to your defender.
